survey: A yellow duck spring rider on sand. Main parts: (1) a flat blue square base plate lying on the sand, seen slightly from above so its top face shows as a shallow parallelogram, with a thin front edge visible; (2) a vertical metal coil spring rising from the centre of the plate, with coils drawn as shallow ellipses whose visible upper arcs match the same slightly high camera; (3) a blue round cap at the top of the spring where it meets the duck's belly, also a shallow ellipse seen from above; (4) the duck body, seen mostly side-on and turned slightly toward three-quarters, sitting upright on the spring; (5) the red seat on the back, whose top surface is slightly visible from above; (6) the red handle pegs that go through the neck, one sticking out on each side (the far one shows as a small red stub left of the neck); (7) the head and beak, facing left in profile. The plate lies flat on the sand at the same angle as the ground plane, and pebbles and the shadow sit on that plane. The spring stays vertical and is centred on both the plate and the cap.
